0: The above and the Servant, accompanied by Osip. Bobchinsky peeps in at the door. SERVANT. Did your Honor wish anything?
1: KHLESTAKOV. Yes, let me have the bill.
2: SERVANT. I gave you the second one a little while ago.
3: KHLESTAKOV. Oh, I can't remember your stupid accounts. Tell me what the whole comes to.
4: SERVANT. You were pleased to order dinner the first day. The second day you only took salmon. And then you took everything on credit.
5: KHLESTAKOV. Fool! [Starts to count it all up now.] How much is it altogether?
6: GOVERNOR. Please don't trouble yourself. He can wait. [To the Servant.] Get out of here. The money will be sent to you.
7: KHLESTAKOV. Yes, that's so, of course. [He puts the money in his pocket.]
8: The Servant goes out. Bobchinsky peeps in at the door.
